SELECT poi_name, amenity, ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%schoolhouse gallery%' LIMIT 1)::geography) AS distance_meters
FROM pois p
WHERE amenity = 'fast_food'
  AND ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%schoolhouse gallery%' LIMIT 1)::geography, 1000)
ORDER BY p.geometry <-> (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%schoolhouse gallery%' LIMIT 1)
LIMIT 1;
